title: Vivot
description: Vivot is a civic participation prototype seeking support to become a reliable public-interest product for real-world use.
heroLede: Vivot already shows how petitions and polls can feel simpler and clearer. To turn this prototype into a secure product people can truly use, we are actively looking for support, partners, and institutional contacts, especially in government and municipalities.
microSupportText: If you work in government, a municipality, or a public institution, we would be glad to hear from you.
panelNoteTitle: If you work in government, research, or public funding:
panelNoteText: This project is looking for the right support to grow from prototype to usable public-interest infrastructure. We would be glad to talk.
missionCardTwoTitle: A simple app for petitions and polls.
missionCardTwoText: Later, ideally with stronger identity and e-ID support.
missionCardThreeText: Especially from government, municipalities, foundations, research, and other public institutions.
storyOneTitle: Still a prototype. But a serious one.
storyOneText: The foundation already works. To turn it into a dependable offering for real participation processes, we are looking for the right supporters and institutional contributors.
storyListOne: Support to turn the prototype into a clean, safe product.
storyListTwo: Partners for stronger identity checks, e-ID, and responsible real-world rollout.
storyListThree: Connections into government, politics, municipalities, or public funding programs.
contactText: If you have a strong idea and interest in cooperation, get in touch with the Trainvent team.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy - Stimmapp
privacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Trainvent provides the Stimmapp service. This page explains the general privacy rules for the app and links to the specific notice for crash diagnostics.
privacyPolicy.overviewPurpose: When you use Stimmapp, we process personal data only as needed to provide and improve the service, secure accounts, respond to support requests, and meet legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.overviewAds: Stimmapp does not show advertising, does not use advertising networks, and does not process personal data for personalized ads or ad measurement.
privacyPolicy.overviewData: This can include account details you provide directly, technical data needed to operate the app, and information generated while you use app features. Some processing is handled by third-party providers such as Google Play Services and Firebase products.
privacyPolicy.noticesIntro: The privacy information is split into these parts:
privacyPolicy.thirdParties: Stimmapp may use third-party services that process data on our behalf or as independent providers in connection with core app functionality. These services are not used to serve ads in Stimmapp.
privacyPolicy.providers: We may work with service providers to host infrastructure, authenticate users, store content, deliver support, detect abuse, and measure app stability. They may access personal data only as needed to provide those services.
privacyPolicy.security: We use commercially reasonable safeguards to protect personal data. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure, so absolute security cannot be guaranteed.
privacyPolicy.links: The app or website may link to third-party sites. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies.
privacyPolicy.children: The service is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
privacyPolicy.changes: We may update this page from time to time. Material changes will be published on this page together with an updated effective date.
privacyPolicy.contact: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact

privacyPolicyCrashData.title: Privacy Policy: Crash Data - Stimmapp
privacyPolicyCrashData.heading: Privacy Policy: Crash Data
privacyPolicyCrashData.intro: This notice explains how Stimmapp handles crash diagnostics and similar technical error data.
privacyPolicyCrashData.data: If the app crashes or behaves unexpectedly, technical diagnostics may include device model, operating system version, app version, time of the error, approximate diagnostics about app state, and identifiers needed to distinguish repeated failures.
privacyPolicyCrashData.purpose: We use crash data to detect errors, reproduce problems, improve stability, prevent abuse, and make the app more reliable.
privacyPolicyCrashData.choice: Stimmapp provides a Privacy Settings control for crash logs. You can enable or disable sending crash logs there at any time. If the setting is shown as enabled, crash diagnostics may be sent when an app error occurs.
privacyPolicyCrashData.providers: Crash diagnostics may be processed through Firebase services or similar technical infrastructure providers used to run and monitor the app.
privacyPolicyCrashData.retention: Crash diagnostics are retained only for as long as reasonably needed for stability analysis, debugging, security, and operational documentation.
privacyPolicyCrashData.contact: Questions about crash-data processing can be sent to

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service - StimmApp
termsOfService.heading: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: This page provides provisional terms of service for StimmApp until the final legal version is published.
termsOfService.purpose: StimmApp enables users to create and participate in petitions and polls.
termsOfService.responsibleUse: Users agree not to publish unlawful, offensive, pornographic, hateful, threatening, or misleading content. StimmApp applies a zero-tolerance policy toward objectionable content and abusive behavior.
termsOfService.enforcement: Users can report content and block other users. Blocked users are hidden from the personal feed immediately. Reports about objectionable content are reviewed within 24 hours. Violations may result in content removal and suspension or permanent termination of the responsible account.
termsOfService.account: You are responsible for the security of your account. If you suspect misuse, contact support.
termsOfService.changes: These terms may be updated. The current version will always be published on this page.
termsOfService.license: StimmApp is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0).
